description.en: The member accounts in Cloud Firewall.

title.zh: 更新云防火墙成员账号信息

descriptions.zh:
本接口一般用于更新云防火墙成员账号信息。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
This operation updates the attributes of member accounts in Cloud Firewall.

## QPS limit

This operation has a queries per second (QPS) limit of 10 for each user. If you exceed this limit, API calls are rate-limited. This may affect your business operations. Plan your calls accordingly.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudfw modify-instance-member-attributes --members MemberDesc=renewal MemberUid=1234123412340000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudfw ModifyInstanceMemberAttributes --region cn-hangzhou --Members.1.MemberDesc renewal --Members.1.MemberUid 1234123412340000 --method POST --force
